title: faux orchid plant
text: faux orchid plant. I was pretty disappointed.  Most of the skinny leaves had bare wires that were detached from the leaves.  The "roots" are horrid and look very fake.  The funny "mossed" balls at the base of the plant are OK but not great.  Further the faux orchid flowers are very cheap and awkward looking - not graceful at all.  And, they put one tiny polished rock on one side of the plant balls and one on the other side, embedded in some clear epoxy meant to look like water? But, there is a dirty, sticky part that is brushed out in front of each rock.  So... I made an additional purchase of polished rocks to cover those spots and that helped.  However, it doesn't uplift the bouquet enough to recommend it.  Of course, this is my opinion.  But I purchased a different faux orchid bouquet a few days ago and I think I will get another one of those and donate this one..  initially I didn't love it but after this one - I appreciate it a lot more.
